title: Semi-implicit Euler energy drift is exactly -n |g|^2 dt^2 / 2; kinetic energy bounded

tol.derivation: tau_v(n) = 2 n ulp(V); tau_x(n) = n q + n ulp(V dt) + n^2 dt ulp(V); V = |v0| + |g| dt steps; q = 2^-32 m
tol.source: per step: two roundings of v (fl(dx), * 1/dt), one quantization and one rounding of x, plus the integrated velocity error; u = 2^-23 (WGSL rounding direction unspecified, §15.7.4: faithful rounding)
